component.name: notm
component.summary: Read and manage mail in a Notmuch database

description.p: notm is a native GTK desktop mail client for existing Notmuch mail stores. It provides a column-based, keyboard-friendly interface for searching, reading, composing, and tagging mail while leaving storage and synchronization under the user's control.
The Flatpak includes the Notmuch command-line tool and msmtp. An existing Notmuch configuration, database, and mail store are required; consult the Flatpak setup guide before first launch.
Improve UI responsiveness, draft and attachment durability, MIME and tag-operation correctness, Visual HTML privacy, and release integrity.
Add support for using notm as the default mailto handler.
